family: Longer playful final-score melodies with complete cadences and natural decay
scope: Three new final-score alternatives D, E and F for Sound Lab. No current files, runtime defaults or UI changed.
status: Three single successful takes downloaded, decoded, end-envelope checked and level matched. Subjective listening acceptance pending.
notes: The user liked the playful longer character of Little victory but perceived a cut ending. These are new 3.5-second generations with explicit complete melodies and final tonic resolution before a long natural decay; no old sound is padded.
Exact original prompts and generation identifiers are retained; signed media download URLs are excluded.

One successful generation per alternative. No retries were needed: all source final 500 ms windows are more than 35 dB below the strongest 50 ms RMS, and final 100 ms windows are more than 45 dB below.
All 3.48 decoded seconds are retained because D and F have natural decays reaching about 2.9 seconds. No content trimming, added silence, pitch shifting or spectral filtering.

Each preview is normalized toward -12.25 dBFS using 4x oversampled peaks with an optional measured correction pass. A 2 ms attack fade and 40 ms tail fade apply only at the file edges; the tail fade starts at 3.44 seconds, after the existing source decay is already low.
Source and output 10 ms RMS envelopes, strongest 50 ms RMS, final 500/100/40/25 ms levels relative to active RMS, sample/4x peaks, hashes and decode status are recorded.
Envelope checks establish quiet decaying endings, not the subjective satisfaction of the musical cadence. Melody, mood, speaker balance and user acceptance still require listening.

clips.label: Bright victory
clips.prompt: A playful little game victory melody, bright friendly bell-like synth chimes in C major. Five cheerful notes: C E G A then a satisfying high C resolution. Play the WHOLE melody within the first 1.4 seconds, then let the final note decay naturally to complete silence by 2.8 seconds, leaving silence at the end of this 3.5-second file. Warm clean sound, modest sparkle, not a loud fanfare. No eerie tone, pitch wobble, voices or bass boom.

clips.label: Bouncy finish
clips.prompt: A happy compact end-of-game flourish: bouncy tuned wooden percussion with a soft clean synth pluck, warm major-key melody, six jaunty notes ending on a satisfying tonic. Finish all notes by 1.5 seconds; let the last note ring and decay naturally to silence by 2.8 seconds, then keep the rest of this 3.5-second file silent. Friendly lively board-game reward, no big fanfare. No eerie ambience, wobble, voices, hard clang or heavy bass.

clips.label: Pocket arcade
clips.prompt: A cheerful tiny retro synth victory arpeggio, rounded clean triangle-wave plinks in a bright major key, playful upward skips then a charming resolving tonic note. Complete the whole five-note melody in the first 1.6 seconds. Allow a full natural final-note decay to silence by 2.8 seconds, leaving quiet space before this 3.5-second file ends. Fun, friendly and clear, never loud or frantic. No alarm, harsh buzz, eerie tones, voices or drums.
